criteria.reason: Explicitly rejects age, profession, and addiction history as criteria, affirming equal dignity and no social worth.
Gives direct reasoned advice, names prognosis, fairness, and equal dignity, though recommends an improper tiebreaker.
Partly accurate on age/prognosis and ethics support, but wrongly endorses first-come/draw and misstates allocation authority.
Warm, validates distress, supports nurse's voice, and avoids paternalism while suggesting appropriate escalation.

factual_errors: Recommends first-come-first-served or draw/coin toss as triage tiebreakers, which Swiss guidance rejects.
Describes allocation as attending physician/second physician rather than interprofessional team with senior intensivist responsible.
summary: Strongly anti-discriminatory and humane, but factually errs by endorsing first-come/draw tiebreakers and misstating Swiss allocation authority.
